clue.text: Tell a close friend

definitions.meaning: to hint at or make known, a verb
a confidant, someone one is very near to, a noun

explanation.surface: Advice to share a confidence with one's best pal.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means to hint or let it be known; as a noun it means a very familiar companion.

clue.text: Priceless local offer

parts.note: priceless read as costing nothing, and a local as a pub, whose offer is a pint of ale

explanation.surface: An unbeatable deal from the neighbourhood shop.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'local' is British slang for one's nearby pub; 'priceless' is read as 'without price', not 'invaluable'.
explanation.definitionFit: Drink handed out at a pub without charge is the idiom for something given away gratis.

clue.text: Joined forces and hit the enemy over the head

definitions.meaning: teamed up, pooled money or effort together

definitions.text: hit the enemy over the head
definitions.meaning: struck with a cudgel

explanation.surface: Allies teamed up and then beat their foe senseless.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to combine with others for a purpose and to beat with a heavy stick.

clue.text: Fix up the procedure for a barn dance

definitions.meaning: mend, restore to working order

definitions.text: the procedure for a barn dance
definitions.meaning: dancers swap partners and team up again

explanation.surface: Mending the routine for a country dance.
explanation.walkthrough: A barn dance is a country dance where couples keep changing partners, so it involves pairing up again and again.
explanation.definitionFit: To mend something is to restore it; in a barn dance one pairs off anew with each partner.

clue.text: A lot of chickens the driver lets out to run

definitions.meaning: a brood of chicks hatched together

definitions.text: the driver lets out to run
definitions.meaning: the pedal a motorist releases so the engine drives the car

explanation.surface: A farmer's driver releases the hens to roam.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a batch of eggs or hatchlings and also the car pedal that engages the gearbox when released.

clue.text: Domestic card player who bids for anything

parts.note: a general is an old word for a maid of all work, a domestic servant
the dealer is the card player who gives out the hands

explanation.surface: A servant who plays cards and will bid for any lot at auction.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'general' (short for general servant) was a household maid who did every task.
explanation.definitionFit: A trader in all sorts of goods will make an offer on any item at all.

clue.text: Contravene German currency restrictions and it will be held against you

definitions.meaning: read literally: obtain a mark, the old German money, on the illicit market

definitions.text: it will be held against you
definitions.meaning: receive a demerit on one's record

explanation.surface: Illegal money dealings in Germany will count against you.
explanation.walkthrough: The mark was Germany's currency before the euro; the black market is illegal trade dodging restrictions.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally, acquiring Deutschmarks illicitly; idiomatically, earning a note of disapproval on one's record.

clue.text: Sermons recant changes leading to protests

indicators.note: changes tells us that the words sermons and recant are rearranged together

explanation.surface: A preacher alters his sermons after recanting, prompting objections.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' rearranges SERMONS and RECANT together; 'leading to' just links wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal objections or complaints are expressions of strong disagreement.

clue.text: Try one's best to break rivets

indicators.note: to break the word rivets is to split it up and reform its letters

explanation.surface: Making a real effort to snap some metal fasteners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' is the anagram signal on RIVETS; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a great effort is to exert oneself fully.

clue.text: Conduct to overcome a prison sentence

parts.note: to beat is to defeat or overcome
time is slang for a jail term

explanation.surface: Behaviour that gets one out of a jail term.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conduct' looks like a noun meaning behaviour; it is the verb a conductor does with a baton.
explanation.definitionFit: A conductor marks the rhythm for an orchestra, keeping the tempo with a baton.

clue.text: Reversible apron-top

indicators.note: reversible says the letters read the same either way round

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: An apron upper that can be worn either way out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reversible' suggests a garment worn inside out; here it means the word is a palindrome.
explanation.definitionFit: The bib is the upper part of an apron or dungarees, covering the chest.

clue.text: Burning a mark on a tree

parts.note: a blaze is a mark cut into bark to show a trail

explanation.surface: A forester's trail mark set on fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on fire is aflame, alight.

clue.text: Design hope near! For the deaf

indicators.note: design means to plan or arrange anew, so the letters of hope and near are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hopeful cry that a new design is close, for those who cannot hear.
explanation.definitionFit: A device placed at the ear to amplify sound is used by people hard of hearing.

clue.text: He produced poems without writing

indicators.note: without means the writing is taken away from the word poems

parts.note: MS is short for manuscript, a piece of writing

explanation.surface: A poet who composed verse without putting pen to paper.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove MS (manuscript) from POEMS; the whole clue also describes the American poet Edgar Allan Poe.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgar Allan Poe wrote verse such as The Raven.

clue.text: Wine manufactured by terrorist organisation

parts.note: made means manufactured
the IRA, the Irish Republican Army

explanation.surface: A drink produced by a paramilitary group.
explanation.definitionFit: Madeira is a fortified dessert wine from the Portuguese Atlantic island.

clue.text: That is about 100 below boiling point!

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the abbreviation for that is surrounds the hundred

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
C is the Roman numeral for 100

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that a temperature is a hundred degrees short of boiling.
explanation.walkthrough: Water at 100 degrees Celsius below boiling is at freezing point, which gives the playful definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Frozen water is far colder than water at the bubbling stage.

clue.text: Early primate

definitions.meaning: before being late
a primate is an archbishop, a senior churchman

explanation.surface: An ancestral ape.
explanation.definitionFit: Split as pre-late it means before late, i.e. early; whole, it is a bishop of high rank, like a primate in the church.

clue.text: Bombard nuclear particles to produce salad vegetables

parts.note: to ram is to strike forcefully, bombard
pions are subatomic mesons

explanation.surface: Smashing atoms to make lettuce.
explanation.definitionFit: Rampion is a bellflower whose roots and leaves were eaten in salads.

clue.text: Latin poems a sailor looks to for guidance

parts.note: odes are lyric poems
a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A seaman consults classical verse for direction.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as what one looks to for guidance, the guiding star.
explanation.definitionFit: The pole star that navigators steer by; figuratively, any guiding principle.

clue.text: Tiny matter in any physical science

indicators.note: in means the tiny matter sits inside the word any

parts.note: an atom is a minute particle of matter

explanation.surface: Minute particles in any branch of physics.
explanation.definitionFit: The study of bodily structure is a branch of biological science dealing with the physical body.

clue.text: Ordered leeks by the ton, but still a bony figure

indicators.note: ordered means put into a new order, so the letters of leeks are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone buys leeks in huge quantity yet stays thin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ordered' looks like buying; it rearranges LEEKS to SKELE, then TON is added; 'by the' and 'but still' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: The framework of bones in a body; also slang for a very thin person.

clue.text: The leader so it was said was Schubert!

indicators.note: so it was said signals a word that sounds like the clue words when spoken

parts.note: the chief, head person

explanation.surface: A claim that Schubert was the head man.
explanation.walkthrough: Schubert wrote over 600 German art songs, so his name stands for them by association.
explanation.definitionFit: German art songs, of which Schubert was the great composer, are named by his output.

clue.text: Pamphlets covering lots of ground

definitions.meaning: short printed leaflets, often religious
expanses of land

explanation.surface: Leaflets that deal with a broad range of topics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covering' is just a link here; the surface sense of covering a lot of ground hides the second sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both short tracts of propaganda and large areas of land.

clue.text: Short Mediterranean street running through Rochester

parts.note: Med is the short form of Mediterranean
way is a common word for a road or street

explanation.surface: A small Mediterranean lane in an English cathedral city.
explanation.walkthrough: The Medway is a river in Kent, south-east England, flowing through the town of Rochester.
explanation.definitionFit: The river flows through the Kent town on its way to the Thames estuary.

clue.text: A record to which mountaineers aspire

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A climbing feat that every mountaineer hopes to achieve.
explanation.definitionFit: A high mountain peak in Switzerland is something climbers aim to reach.

clue.text: Leave some to join in

definitions.meaning: read as removing only a portion, leaving the rest
participate

explanation.surface: Advice to leave a little and get involved.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking only a portion leaves the rest behind; the idiom also means participate.

clue.text: Any six-footer who has been successfully proselytised

definitions.meaning: a creature with six legs
someone converted into a religious group

explanation.surface: A tall man who has been converted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'six-footer' suggests a tall person; it means a six-legged creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A bug has six legs; split, the word says someone is now inside a religious group.

clue.text: People with taking ways who should really be patient

definitions.meaning: compulsive thieves, those who take things
people whose condition makes them patients needing treatment

explanation.surface: Charming people who ought to show more patience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking ways' suggests charm; it means stealing. 'patient' suggests forbearance; it means one under medical care.
explanation.definitionFit: Compulsive stealers have a recognised disorder that calls for treatment.
